### A Prayer about Jesus Rising for the Occasion of Our Need
Author: Scotty Smith
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/scotty-smith/a-prayer-about-jesus-rising-for-the-occasion-of-our-need/
Passage: Acts 7:55-56
Points:
- Stephen's vision reveals Christ rising to actively support and care for His servant during his greatest trial.
- Jesus at the right hand of God signifies sovereign reign rather than passivity or absence.
- Remembering Christ's completed redemption helps believers overcome doubts and feelings of abandonment in hard times.
- Believers can ask the Holy Spirit for spiritual sight to keep their gaze fixed firmly on Jesus.

### Just One
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/harvest-daily-feb-15-2007-11529751.html
Passage: Acts 7:60–8:1
Points:
- Stephen showed profound Christlike grace by praying that his murderers' sin would not be held against them.
- Stephen's ministry was not measured by large numbers, yet his dying testimony left a lasting mark on Saul of Tarsus.
- Faithful obedience to God's calling defines true success rather than earthly metrics.
- Proclaiming God's Word is never unfruitful, even when hearers respond with hostility and rejection.
